panels.title: Cost per Case (USD) — median / p95 / max
panels.description: Per-case total cost recorded by SagaMetrics.recordCaseCost on terminal/suspend transitions (NFR-O-003).

panels.title: Decision Rate by Outcome
panels.description: Counter incremented by Supervisor.decide() at aggregation time, tagged by FR-DP-002 outcome.

panels.title: Compensation Rate
panels.description: Share of terminal cases that reached COMPENSATED. clamp_min(...,1) avoids divide-by-zero before the first terminal lands.

panels.title: Specialist Latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: p95 of Timer(agentpay.specialist.latency) per agent, multiplied by 1000 so the y-axis reads as ms.

panels.title: Eval Pass Rate
panels.description: Populated when a Prometheus textfile collector is wired in a future iteration; until then the eval runner writes evals/results/latest.json and prints a summary line to stdout. Panel intentionally left in place so the dashboard schema stays stable across iterations.
